description: This file defines the DataGroupPermission class in the OrangeHRM system, representing permissions associated with user roles for data groups, including attributes and methods to instantiate from an array and access permissions.

classes.name: DataGroupPermission
classes.description: Represents a set of permissions for a user role in data groups within the OrangeHRM system, including properties for read, create, update, delete, and self permissions, with methods for instantiation and permission checks.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a DataGroupPermission object with specified user role and permissions.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Creates a DataGroupPermission object from an associative array representing role and permission settings.

methods.name: getUserRole
methods.description: Returns the user role associated with this permission set.

methods.name: canRead
methods.description: Checks if read permission is granted.

methods.name: canCreate
methods.description: Checks if create permission is granted.

methods.name: canUpdate
methods.description: Checks if update permission is granted.

methods.name: canDelete
methods.description: Checks if delete permission is granted.

methods.name: isSelf
methods.description: Checks if self permission is granted.
